nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: When was DEET first documented in fresh-water environments?
nodes.answer: DEET was first documented in fresh-water environments throughout the 1990s in American and European regions.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Water quality monitoring|Pathogen tracking systems_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What software was used to characterize the ITS2 types present in the samples?
nodes.answer: The software used to characterize the ITS2 types present in the samples was SymPortal.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Water quality monitoring|Pathogen tracking systems_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What methods are mentioned for obtaining genomic datasets?
nodes.answer: Double digest Restriction Associated DNA sequencing (RAD-seq) and sequence-capture methods are mentioned for obtaining genomic datasets.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Water quality monitoring|Pathogen tracking systems_qna_003
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What tool was used to process the DNA samples after extraction?
nodes.answer: Quantitative PCR (qPCR) using the QuantStudio 3 (Applied Biosystems, USA) was used to process the DNA samples after extraction.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Water quality monitoring|Pathogen tracking systems_qna_004
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What type of sequencing platform was utilized in this study?
nodes.answer: The Illumina platform was used for sequencing.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Water quality monitoring|Pathogen tracking systems_qna_005
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What pathogen is associated with Desmodus rotundus in the context of this study?
nodes.answer: Desmodus rotundus is a reservoir for the rabies virus.
